name: Personal To-Do List with Categories
description: A simple to-do list application where a user can create, view, complete, and delete tasks organized by categories.

business_context.name: TaskMaster
business_context.description: I run a small consulting business and need a simple way to track my daily tasks and organize them by project.

problem_statement.problem: I need to track my daily tasks and organize them by project or category. Right now I use sticky notes and keep losing them.
problem_statement.current_process: Sticky notes and a paper notebook

requested.description: Add new tasks with a title and optional description
Organize tasks into categories or projects
Delete tasks I no longer need
See all my tasks in one view, filterable by category

data.entities: Task title, task description, category name, completion status, date created

meta.notes: Keep it simple, I just want something that works.

expected_features: Create a new task with title and description
Assign a task to a category
unit_tests: API: POST /tasks creates a new task and returns it with an ID
API: PUT /tasks/:id with completed=true marks task complete
API: POST /categories creates a new category
Frontend: Task list page renders without errors
Frontend: Add task form exists and has required fields
